'''Immalleable''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the SRP Mod. This Effect can disable the [[Adaptation System]], as long as the it lasts.

Immalleable cannot be removed by drinking Milk.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Currently, the Immalleable Effect can only be obtained throughout Cheats and the usage of Creative Mode.
